Chapter 434 - 434 Mission; Toy Factory!

Chapter 434 - 434 Mission; Toy Factory!

434 Mission; Toy Factory!

Lin Fan had been paying attention to the changes in Hu Shaodong’s body.

After pondering for a moment, he spent another ten million yuan to buy a bottle of Medical Water from the system.

“Second Brother Hu, drink another bottle.”

Hu Shaodong was still in a state of shock.

Hence, he did not hear Lin Fan’s words at all.

Lin Fan could only open his mouth again, “Second Brother Hu, open your mouth.”

Hu Shaodong finally reacted and replied, “Ah… Alright.”

His voice was no longer as hoarse as before, and it sounded energized, as though his health had returned to normal.

The second bottle of Medical Water went down his throat.

Hu Shaodong felt warm and comfortable.

To outsiders, the wounds on his body healed even faster.

Lin Fan had been staring at the changes in Hu Shaodong’s body. Then, he spent another ten million yuan to buy a bottle of Medical Water from the system.

A bottle of Medical Water could cure countless illnesses.

After three bottles, the effects were multiplied!

In the blink of an eye, the wounds on Hu Shaodong’s body lessened.

About ten minutes later…

All his wounds had healed.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan sighed.

Hu Shaodong’s legs had not recovered yet.

Hu Tian could not help but ask, “Brother, how do you feel?””

Hu Shaodong clenched his fists and said in a powerful voice, “I’m fine. I feel like I’m fine now!”

Hu Nanshan nodded repeatedly.

Then, he said to Hu Shaodong, “Shaodong, hurry up and thank Lin Fan!”

Even Hu Nanshan had never heard of a medicine that could heal wounds in such a short time.

Medicine?

In Hu Nanshan’s opinion… Perhaps, this could not simply be called medicine!

It was divine medicine!

Without a doubt, its value was immeasurable!

Yet, Lin Fan was willing to take out three bottles in a row. This was definitely a huge favor!

Hu Shaodong also understood this and said seriously, “Lin Fan, thank you.”

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “Second Brother, you don’t have to be so polite… Besides, I didn’t really manage to help you.”

As he spoke, he could not help but look down at Hu Shaodong’s legs.

“It’s good enough,” Hu Shaodong said dejectedly. “After all, it’s impossible for legs to grow back.”

At this moment, Lin Fan’s head rang out with a clear sound.

[Ding! Mission: Buy one million toys and make 100 different toys. Reward: Perfect artificial limbs, as well as the machinery, tools, and principles for making artificial limbs.]

When Lin Fan heard that, his expression changed slightly. “I have a way to make Second Brother Hu stand up!”

As soon as he said this, everyone present revealed an unconcealable excitement.

However, Lin Fan then said, “Teacher Tiantian, do you know if there’s a large toy factory in Sha City?”

A large toy factory?

Did he not say that he could make Hu Shaodong stand up?

Why was he suddenly asking about a toy factory?

Although everyone was puzzled, Hu Tian still replied, “There are some toy factories in the north of the city.”

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright.”

After saying that, he did not say anything else and strode out.

Only the Hu family members were left looking at each other.

Was the toy factory related to helping Hu Shaodong stand up?

He could not possibly use a toy to stand up, right?

Lin Fan sat in the Cullinan and headed toward the north of the city.

After a while, he arrived in front of a rather large factory called Qinqin Toy.

The security guard at the door quickly noticed Lin Fan and said, “Hello, what’s the matter?”

Lin Fan said,” Tell your factory manager that I want to buy the toy factory!”

Lin Fan’s thoughts were simple.

The mission was to buy one million toys.

It would definitely be very slow to buy them in bulk.

The simplest and most direct method was to buy the entire factory.

In this way, the toys in the factory would be bought by him!

In addition, Lin Fan needed to make 100 different toys.

It would be more convenient to buy a factory and make them himself.

However, the security guard was stunned by his words.

Anyone who suddenly heard that someone wanted to buy a huge factory would be a little stunned.

Moreover, the other party was a young man.

At this moment, a Porsche Cayenne drove over from afar.

The security guard immediately stood up straight and said, “Hello, Factory Manager Yao!”

Then…

A middle-aged man with a big belly slowly walked down.

Factory Manager Yao nodded to show his greeting.

“What happened here?” he asked.

The security guard hesitated for a moment, but he did not know what to say.

Should he directly say that this young man wanted to buy the toy factory?

The factory manager would definitely scold him, right?

Lin Fan said, “You came at the right time. I want to buy your factory!”

Factory Manager Yao was also stunned for a moment.

Obviously, he did not expect Lin Fan to have such a request.

Factory Manager Yao could not help but size Lin Fan up. He realized that Lin Fan’s expression was calm, as if he was not joking.

After a while, Factory Manager Yao finally said, “Our Qinqin Toy Factory is doing very well. Our annual profit is more than ten million yuan, and it’s still expanding. For the time being, I have no intention of selling it, so I can only apologize to you.”

If Lin Fan were just an ordinary young man, Factory Manager Yao would not have bothered saying so much.

In fact, he would not even have gotten out of the car.

It was because Lin Fan was driving a luxury car that was worth tens of millions of yuan—Rolls-Royce Cullinan!

Lin Fan acted like he did not hear him and said, “500 million yuan!”

Factory Manager Yao’s body stiffened slightly.

500 million yuan!

In fact, their factory was only worth some money.

The machines and raw materials were not worth much money.

If it were a big brand toy factory, there might be some brand value.

However, Qinqin Toy Factory had only been established for a few years and had no brand value at all.

500 million yuan!

It definitely exceeded the actual price of the factory!

Seeing that Manager Yao did not say anything, Lin Fan said again, “1 billion yuan!”

One billion yuan!

This was not the actual price of the factory but several times more!

Factory Manager Yao felt his throat go dry.

Seeing that Manager Yao still did not answer, Lin Fan frowned slightly and said, “Two billion yuan!”

At this moment, Factory Manager Yao finally reacted and hurriedly said, “I’ll sell it!”

“If you need it, I can leave all the materials, workers, equipment, sales channels, and so on to you!” Factory Manager Yao continued.

Not selling?

It was just that the price was not high enough!

Lin Fan nodded his head in satisfaction. “Alright!”

Seeing that Manager Yao was still standing beside him, he frowned again and asked, “What are you still standing there for? Go and draw up the contract. Today, I’ll become the boss of Qinqin Toy Factory!”

“Yes, Sir!” Factory Manager Yao hurriedly responded and jogged back to the car. Then, he quickly went into the factory.
